flags.reason: misreads-source: The guide says the opposite: "nothing cuts the title or body short" (anatomy, sizing), "the card doesn’t cut either short" (content), and the evidence says "Nothing clamps the title or body" and "No card-level ... clamping" on the checked 0.1.78 build. Stating that the title clamps to one line and the body to three, with disableTruncation as the way out, contradicts the guide.

misreads-source: The guide's sources section says "ratingMediaAlign doesn’t move the default badge", and the evidence says it "doesn't move the default Badge (Badge has its own alignSelf: flex-start)" and was "described only". Saying it aligns the badge slot to center or start presents it as working.

notes: Several type-derived items conflict with what the guide and evidence record for the checked build (0.1.78 at a116616, 19 October). /configuration/8, /configuration/9, /anatomy/5 and /anatomy/6 add badge and caption on cta, but the guide says "the package’s cta shows an icon and no badge or caption". /accessibility/0 and /accessibility/1 describe naming props, but the evidence says "Capsule and Avatar are role=img with no name". These types probably come from the newer dbe0e02 install, which changed CardCTA for #345. The evidence says that build's "copy wasn't re-checked" and "waits for #345's own publish". A human should decide which build the entry describes, then either re-check the guide against dbe0e02 or drop or qualify these items, including the two flagged above. Minor point: /content/good includes "Your credit score rose" and "Save" from configuration examples, not from the content section.
